programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Soke (Billy Bob Thornton) teams up with his angry little sidekick, Marcus, to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity. Mommy issues arise when the pair are joined by Willie's horror story of a mother, Sunny Soke, who raises the bar for the gang's ambitions, while somehow lowering the standards of criminal behavior.

programme.title: Office Christmas Party
programme.desc: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules.

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally...
programme.desc: In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco.

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: Following the death of Vesper Lynd, James Bond (Daniel Craig) makes his next mission personal. The hunt for those who blackmailed his lover leads him to ruthless businessman Dominic Greene (Mathieu Amalric), a key player in the organization which coerced Vesper. Bond learns that Greene is plotting to gain total control of a vital natural resource, and he must navigate a minefield of danger and treachery to foil the plan.

programme.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
programme.desc: Secret ops assassin Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) is sent on a mission up a river during the Vietnam War to "terminate with extreme prejudice" the errant Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando). In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated.

programme.title: V for Vendetta
programme.desc: Following the world war, London is a police state occupied by a fascist government, and a vigilante known only as V uses terrorist tactics to fight the oppressors of the world in which he now lives. When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime.

programme.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: As Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) ages, he finds that being the head of the Corleone crime family isn't getting any easier. He wants his family out of the Mafia, but the mob kingpin (Eli Wallach) isn't eager to let one of the most powerful and wealthy families go legit. Making matters even worse is Michael's nephew, Vincent (Andy Garcia). Not only does Vincent want a piece of the Corleone family's criminal empire, but he also wants Michael's daughter, Mary (Sofia Coppola).

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: In 1999, Ken Carter (Samuel L. Jackson) returns to his old high school in Richmond, California, to get the basketball team into shape. With tough rules and academic discipline, he succeeds in setting the players on a winning streak. But when their grades start to suffer, Carter locks them out of the gym and shuts down their championship season. When he is criticized by the players and their parents, he sticks to his guns, determined that they excel in class as well as on the court.

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: When God decides that mankind has become too sinful and must be wiped off the Earth, he chooses Noah (Russell Crowe), a pious man, for a great task. Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

programme.title: Cold Mountain
programme.desc: In this classic story of love and devotion set against the backdrop of the American Civil War, a wounded Confederate soldier named W.P. Inman (Jude Law) deserts his unit and travels across the South, aiming to return to his young wife, Ada (Nicole Kidman), who he left behind to tend their farm. As Inman makes his perilous journey home, Ada struggles to keep their home intact with the assistance of Ruby (Renée Zellweger), a mysterious drifter sent to help her by a kindly neighbor.

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart.

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis).

programme.title: The Experts
programme.desc: The KGB shanghais a hip New Yorker and his sidekick to teach square spies how to act like Americans for a secret mission.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha (Julia Roberts) to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart.

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government?

programme.title: Wildling
programme.desc: After a childhood in captivity under the care of a man who taught her to fear the outside world, a young woman sees her new freedom shattered by a series of unsettling events.

programme.title: Hard Rain
programme.desc: The small town of Huntingburg is forced to evacuate when torrential rains bring rising floodwaters. The local sheriff and town residents, having been through this before, are all too familiar with the looting and petty thefts that take place in an abandoned town. What they are not aware of, however, is the planned heist of an armored car sent to transport the $3 million from local banks.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: The Enterprise and its crew follow a Borg ship through a time warp to prevent the Borg from taking over the Earth in a past era. Stuck in the past, Geordi La Forge helps a pioneer of space travel in his efforts to create the first warp drive while Capt. Picard and Cmdr. Data battle the Borg Queen as she tries to take over the Enterprise.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Desperate to raise money for his daughter's cancer treatment, a retired bull rider teams up with his estranged son to orchestrate a robbery. However, they must soon outwit the local police if they want to keep the cash and their freedom.

programme.title: Murder Company
programme.desc: During the D-Day invasion, a group of U.S. soldiers must smuggle a member of the French resistance behind enemy lines to assassinate a high-value Nazi target.

programme.title: V for Vengeance
programme.desc: After learning that their younger sibling escaped an earlier kidnapping attempt that also killed their parents, two estranged sisters must join forces to rescue her from a group of bloodthirsty vampires. Out for revenge and control of a vampirism vaccine, Thorn and his band of the undead soon learn that they messed with the wrong family.

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: A former cop who has been imprisoned for murdering the psychopath who killed his family, Parker Barnes (Denzel Washington) is recruited to test out a new virtual-reality program where the goal is to apprehend a computer-generated being called SID 6.7 (Russell Crowe), who has been modeled on hundreds of deranged criminals. When SID manages to escape into the real world, Barnes must capture or destroy him before the soulless entity can go on a killing spree.

programme.title: Twister
programme.desc: During the approach of the most powerful storm in decades, university professor Dr. Jo Harding (Helen Hunt) and an underfunded team of students prepares the prototype for Dorothy, a ground-breaking tornado data-gathering device conceived by her estranged husband, Bill (Bill Paxton). When Harding tells Bill that Dorothy is ready for testing -- and that their privately funded rival Dr. Jonas Miller (Cary Elwes) has stolen the idea and built his own -- Bill rejoins the team for one last mission.

programme.title: Hostage
programme.desc: After one of his hostage negotiations goes awry, LAPD officer Jeff Talley (Bruce Willis) quits the force and relocates his family to the suburbs. As the sheriff in a sleepy town, Jeff thinks he has escaped the hustle and bustle -- until an elaborate local heist puts him back in the center of a hostage situation. When his own family is pulled into the fray, Jeff is forced to decide whether he should try to help the hostages or follow the criminals' hands-off mandate to protect his own family.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a night club singer and a 12-year old boy.

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them.

programme.title: Mouse Hunt
programme.desc: When their string magnate father, Rudolf Smuntz, dies, brothers Ernie (Nathan Lane) and Lars (Lee Evans) move into his decrepit mansion. Struggling to keep a promise to never sell the now unprofitable string factory, the brothers decide that restoring the house, the last built by a famous architect, could bring them a great deal of money. But during their restoration attempts, Ernie and Lars are continually frustrated by a malicious mouse that keeps destroying their efforts.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: A Federation mission to the planet Ba'ku takes a dangerous turn when a malfunctioning android, Data (Brent Spiner), takes a cultural task force hostage. When Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero and it got a hedgehog. Powered with incredible speed, Sonic races across the globe to stop uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) has defeated his archenemy but at great cost. His friend Spock has apparently been killed, the USS Enterprise is being scrapped, and starship physician Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy (DeForest Kelley) has taken ill. McCoy's odd behavior is evidence he's harboring Spock's katra, or animating spirit, and Kirk seeks to take the Enterprise back to the Genesis Planet and find his friend. Rebuffed, Kirk takes dramatic action that results in war with deadly Klingons.

programme.title: Santa Stole Our Dog!
programme.desc: Members of the Whitehaven family travel to the magical North Pole when their beloved dog Rusty goes missing on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Free Birds
programme.desc: Pardoned by the president, a lucky turkey (Owen Wilson) named Reggie gets to live a carefree lifestyle, until fellow fowl Jake (Woody Harrelson) recruits him for a history-changing mission. Jake and Reggie travel back in time to the year 1621, just before the first Thanksgiving. The plan: Prevent all turkeys from ever becoming holiday dinners. Unfortunately, the two birds encounter colonist Myles Standish (Colm Meaney), out to capture feathered friends for all the hungry Pilgrims.

programme.title: Hotel for Dogs
programme.desc: After moving into a foster home that forbids pets, siblings Andi and Bruce must quickly find a home for their dog, Friday. The resourceful pair finds an abandoned hotel, and with the help of Bruce's mechanical skills, turn it into a pooch paradise for Friday and a number of strays. But when the inevitable barking makes neighbors suspicious, Andi and Bruce must find a way to hide their canine haven from prying eyes.

programme.title: Grumpy Old Men
programme.desc: John Gustafson (Jack Lemmon) and Max Goldman (Walter Matthau) are two curmudgeonly neighbors who have been at each other's throats for years. The rivalry of the former friends intensifies when Ariel (Ann-Margret) comes along and provides a love interest for both of them. When Max finds out that John is experiencing family troubles and financial ruin, however, he steps in to help. Their bond is further cemented when John has a health scare and Max makes the ultimate sacrifice for his friend.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: The Bradys of the popular '70s sitcom get thrust into the '90s, with a whole new set of problems. The family's house is in danger of being taken away by developer Larry Dittmeyer if the ever-positive brood can't come up with $20,000. Parents Mike and Carol initially don't fret, until Mike has difficulty getting any of his architectural designs sold. Fearing the worst, the six Brady kids decide to enter a talent contest and raise the money themselves.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents.

programme.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
programme.desc: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him.

programme.title: Marshmallow
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp.

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery.

programme.title: Anything for Fame
programme.desc: Venturing into the virtual Wild West to profile a new breed of content creator.

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education.

programme.title: Lilies Not for Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another.

programme.title: Jersey Girl
programme.desc: Ollie Trinke is young and at the top of his game as a music promoter. He is both a workaholic and a silver-tongued expert at manipulating the press. At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Steiney, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna.

programme.title: Outside Providence
programme.desc: In this coming-of-age comedy, Tim Dunphy (Shawn Hatosy) is leading a go-nowhere existence, spending his days smoking pot and hanging out with his best friend, Drugs Delaney (Jon Abrahams). But Tim's lazy days of getting high are jettisoned after a brush with the law convinces his blue-collar dad (Alec Baldwin) to send him to a Connecticut prep school. The one saving grace of the new school is Jane (Amy Smart), a fellow student Tim falls for immediately.

programme.title: Stop-Loss
programme.desc: His tour of duty in Iraq finally over, Staff Sgt. Brandon King returns home to Brazos, Texas, ready to re-enter civilian life. Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! The Movie
programme.desc: Arnold (Spencer Klein) and his pal, Gerald (Jamil Walker Smith), learn their beloved neighborhood is about to be torn down by a greedy developer named Scheck (Paul Sorvino) to build a mall. While the adults come up with a dodgy scheme, the friends try a more practical approach to the problem with the help of Helga (Francesca Marie Smith). The kids discover their neighborhood was designated as a historical landmark but they must prove it before Scheck moves in with his crew.

programme.title: A Wonderful Time of the Year
programme.desc: The Marsh family's getting together for their first Christmas Eve after three years of pandemic lockdown.

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them.

programme.title: Rebel in the Rye
programme.desc: Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye.

programme.title: Changeland
programme.desc: A man meets up with his best friend in Thailand while going through a personal crisis.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Killer Joe
programme.desc: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple).

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series.

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear.

programme.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
programme.desc: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician.

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes.

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Dear Santa
programme.desc: When a young boy mails his Christmas wish list to Santa with one crucial spelling error, a devilish Jack Black arrives to wreak havoc on the holidays.

programme.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
programme.desc: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician.

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

programme.title: Restoration
programme.desc: In order to keep one of his mistresses, Celia (Polly Walker), at arm's length, King Charles II (Sam Neill) asks the royal physician, Robert Merivel (Robert Downey Jr.), to marry her under the proviso that they never become intimate. Merivel agrees, only to discover he can't resist Celia, and soon finds himself out of the king's favor. Destitute, he devotes himself to helping Londoners suffering from the plague, and in the process falls in love with an equally poor woman, Katherine (Meg Ryan).

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack.

programme.title: Love, Rosie
programme.desc: Rosie and Alex are best friends until Alex's family moves to America. They gamble everything to keep their love and friendship alive over the years and miles.

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life.

programme.title: Grumpier Old Men
programme.desc: Elderly, angling and contentious friends Max (Walter Matthau) and John (Jack Lemmon) back-burner their bickering when their kids (Kevin Pollak, Daryl Hannah) get engaged, but fishing season opens a can of romantic worms as newcomer Maria (Sophia Loren) plans to turn their beloved bait shop into a restaurant. Botched matchmaking leads to some major romantic mix-ups, until an unexpected death in the family helps everyone realize that the most important thing in life is love.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul.

programme.title: Safe Haven
programme.desc: Katie Feldman moves to a small town on the North Carolina coast, determined to make a new life for herself. She takes a job as a waitress and keeps a low profile, but she is soon won over by the warmth and caring of the close-knit community, especially that of Alex, a widower. With the help of Alex and his children, Katie learns to love and trust again, but when a mysterious stranger arrives and starts asking questions, Katie's dark past threatens to reclaim her.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds.

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha (Julia Roberts) to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes).

programme.title: At War With the Army
programme.desc: When former business partners Vic Puccinelli (Dean Martin) and Alvin Korwin (Jerry Lewis) enlist in the U.S. Army, they have different ambitions. Puccinelli, who has made the rank of sergeant, wants to see action rather than the drudgery of his current post. On the other hand, Korwin, who is a klutz, wants to stay out of combat and near his family in the United States. However, they both have to deal with stern Sgt. McVey (Mike Kellin) while also preparing for an Army variety show.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: When police officers arrive at his home to tell him that he's under "open arrest," unassuming bureaucrat Josef K. (Anthony Perkins) can't imagine what kind of crime he might have committed. He consults first his neighbor (Jeanne Moreau) about the incident, then the courts, then a pompous law advocate (Orson Welles), all to no avail. Ironically, Joseph is able to learn of his sentence - he is to be put to death - but the nature of the charge against him remains elusive.

programme.title: And Then There Were None
programme.desc: In this suspenseful drama, based on Agatha Christie's mystery tale, 10 strangers are summoned to a remote island. While they are waiting for the mysterious host to appear, a recording levels serious accusations at each of the guests, including Judge Francis J. Quinncannon (Barry Fitzgerald) and Dr. Edward G. Armstrong (Walter Huston), and soon they start being murdered, one by one. As the survivors try to keep their wits, they reach a disturbing conclusion: one of them must be the killer.

programme.desc: A community leader holds an 18-year-old Romani woman hostage until she agrees to an arranged marriage to his son.

programme.desc: GP Confidential - Accesul tau complet in Formula 1 Descopera secretele din spatele strategiilor de succes in F1 cu GP Confidential! In 25 de episoade captivante, imbunatatite cu animatii 3D de ultima generatie, patrundem in detaliile tehnice care determina care echipe triumfa in conformitate cu regulile si care esueaza. Dincolo de aceste analize detaliate, prezentam momente de neuitat din istoria F1 si oferim previzualizari palpitante ale curselor. Pentru fiecare pasionat de F1, GP Confidential este o experienta de neratat. Descopera Formula 1 asa cum nu ai mai vazut-o pana acum cu GP Confidential!

programme.title: Highlights_Psccd26_Lausitsring
programme.desc: Porsche Carrera Racing scoate la iveala tot ce este mai bun din piloti, formand o prezenta globala redutabila in lumea seriilor monomarca. Porsche SIXT Carrera Cup Germania constituie unul dintre cele mai prestigioase campionate monomarca la nivel mondial, noul model 911 fiind introdus pentru anul 2026. Completata de campionatele de iarna Sprint Challenge Southern Europe (ianuarie-februarie) si de nou-infiintata Carrera World Cup din martie -- care reuneste cei mai buni piloti din toate cele 35 de campionate regionale -- aceasta reprezinta apogeul curselor Porsche. Mai mult decat o rampa de lansare pentru talentele emergente, Carrera Cup este, prin natura sa, un camp de lupta captivant.

programme.title: Fastzone 2026
programme.desc: FastZone - Actualizarea saptamanala a motorsportului Actualizarea ta saptamanala despre motorsport este distilata intr-un program de o jumatate de ora. Acoperind totul, de la prototipuri la curse de anduranta, karting la avioane si chiar si unele ciudatenii reale... FastZone combina traditia si o perspectiva proaspata asupra motorsportului, devenind sursa ta suprema pentru tot ce este rapid si fascinant!

programme.title: Porsche Sixt Carrera Cup De 2026 - Race 1 - Imola
programme.desc: Porsche Sixt Carrera Cup Deutschland - traditie si performanta. Cu peste 30 de ani de istorie, competitia este unul dintre cele mai importante one-make cups din Europa. Toti campionii sai au confirmat ulterior in motorsportul international, demonstrand nivelul exceptional al grilei. Mai mult decat o rampa de lansare pentru tineri piloti, Carrera Cup Germania este un campionat puternic si competitiv in sine.

programme.title: Highlights Dtm 2026 - Zandvoort
programme.desc: DTM. Acesta este locul unde traditia sportului cu motor prinde viata. Intrat in cel de-al 42-lea sezon, DTM reprezinta esenta motorsportului: combina o fascinatie unica si o atmosfera familiara cu o dinamica inconfundabila! Nu mai putin de noua producatori diferiti (Lamborghini, Ferrari, BMW, Mercedes, Porsche, McLaren, Audi, Ford si Aston Martin) si noua piloti intra in ultimul weekend de concurs cu sanse la titlu... Diversitatea si echilibrul competitiv transforma fiecare weekend DTM intr-un adevarat spectacol! Sustinut de o gama completa de serii secundare, precum ADAC GT Masters, GT4 Germany si altele - pachetul DTM imbina mostenirea istorica cu o forta impresionanta si un spirit tanar!

programme.title: Australian Boat Racing 2025

programme.title: Adac 24h Race 2026 - Nurburgring - Finish

Adauga la acestea 150 de masini - de la modele GT extrem de rapide pana la modesta Dacia Logan - care lupta pentru glorie in permanenta, si vei obtine un spectacol pur, nefiltrat, de la rasarit pana la apus!

programme.title: Dernier détour

programme.title: Le procès du chien

Lorsque Dariuch, client aussi désespéré que sa cause, lui demande de défendre son fidèle compagnon Cosmos, les convictions d'Avril reprennent le dessus. Commence alors un procès aussi inattendu qu'agité : le procès du chien.

programme.title: Fanon

programme.title: 28 ans plus tard

Malgré une quarantaine impitoyable, certains ont trouvé le moyen de survivre parmi les infectés. L'un de ces groupes de survivants vit sur une petite île reliée au continent par une chaussée unique. Lorsque l'un d'entre eux décide de s'aventurer dans le coeur du continent, il découvre une mutation qui s'est propagée non seulement aux infectés, mais aussi aux autres survivants.

programme.title: 28 ans plus tard: le temple des morts
programme.desc: Le Dr Kelson se retrouve embarqué dans une relation bouleversante aux conséquences potentiellement cataclysmiques, tandis que la rencontre de Spike avec Jimmy Crystal vire au cauchemar. Dans le monde de "Le temple des morts," les infectés ne représentent plus la plus grande menace pour la survie: l'inhumanité des survivants peut se révéler plus étrange et plus terrifiante encore.

Mus par une force inébranlable, ils sont partis à la course et personne ne sait où ils s'en sont allés. Tous ont disparu, sauf un. Alex est le seul élève restant. Paniqués et inquiets, les parents soupçonnent l'enseignante Justine Gandy d'avoir manigancé quelque chose.

Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes

programme.title: Three Wishes

Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny.

programme.title: The Fitzgerald Family Christmas
programme.desc: Rifts emerge among family members when their long-estranged patriarch decides to come home for the holidays.

programme.desc: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes.

programme.title: Smart People

Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy.

Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders.

programme.title: Designing Women
programme.desc: Series creator Linda Bloodworth-Thomason uses the fictional Atlanta design firm of Sugarbaker and Associates as a witty bully pulpit for caustic social and political humor. The founder of the company is Julia Sugarbaker, a sharp-tongued but elegant and surprisingly compassionate woman. Her younger sister, Suzanne, is a former beauty queen who is long on charm but a bit slow on the uptake. Their associates are Mary Jo Shively, a recent divorcee, and officer manager Charlene Frazier, whose sweetness is matched only by her naivete. Their deliverman is Anthony Bouvier, a well-spoken ex-convict, and cheerfully dotty senior citizen Bernice Clifton often drops by for a visit as well.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Samantha falls in love with New York ad exec Darrin Stephens and marries him in the first episode of the sitcom. Then Darrin finds out that his new bride is one of a secret society of powerful witches and warlocks and that a twitch of her nose brings magic results. Thoroughly befuddled, Darrin makes her promise never to use her powers. She agrees and tries to settle into being the perfect suburban housewife. Her mother, Endora, however, has a different agenda. She hates that Samantha has married a mortal and continually tries to break them up. Sam's other spellbinding friends and family pop in and out of the Stephens household as Sam tries (and most of the time fails) to live without magic.

programme.title: Maude
programme.desc: Sitcoms come and go. And then there's "Maude," the groundbreaking Norman Lear comedy. The show revolves around Maude Findlay, a very outspoken middle-class woman who wears her liberal politics on her sleeve and shares her home in suburban Tuckahoe, N.Y., with fourth husband Walter; her divorced daughter, Carol; and Carol's adolescent son, Phillip. Walter and Maude's best friends are next-door neighbors Dr. Arthur and Vivian Harmon. Among the domestic help that Maude helps "liberate" during the run of the show are Florida Evans and Mrs. Nell Naugatuck.

The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates.

Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. programme.title: Mini, une grande Histoire
programme.desc: L'épopée de la célèbre Mini, icône culturelle et technique, de sa création à son évolution moderne à travers des archives, des témoignages et des séquences inédites.

programme.title: La saga Lorraine-Dietrich
programme.desc: A la Belle Epoque, "Lorraine-Dietrich" incarne le luxe et l'audace, pionnière des 100km/h et double vainqueur au Mans, symbole du génie industriel français.

programme.title: Supercar Blondie
programme.desc: Bénéficiant d'un accès privilégié à une McLaren Senna exclusive de 2 millions de dollars, Supercar Blondie creuse sous la surface pour découvrir les querelles de gangs dans la communauté SLAB (Slow, Low and Bangin'). Elle rencontre les légendaires ...

programme.title: Supercar Blondie
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie arrive à Las Vegas au volant d'un roadster Lamborghini SVJ d'un million de dollars. Sous l'aile de Patrick, le fondateur des Junkyard Pirates, Alex découvre l'univers des \" rat rods \", refuge des marginaux et anticonformistes américains.

programme.title: Le convoi de l'extrême : le grand frisson
programme.desc: A Winnipeg, Mark Kohaykewych, patron de Polar Industries, constate dès le mois de février les conséquences d'un réchauffement précoce. Darrell Ward et Lisa Kelly subissent aussi les mauvaises conditions météorologiques, qui pourraient causer la faillite de leur société. Todd se rend à Pikangikum pour livrer des matériaux de construction et doit franchir un lac gelé de 16 mètres alors que Darrell honore son premier contrat et se rend à Garden Hill.

programme.title: Le convoi de l'extrême : le grand frisson
programme.desc: En chemin pour Pikangikum, Darrell apprend qu'une partie de la route menant à sa destination vient d'être fermée, à cause de la hausse des températures. Art est de nouveau sur les routes et doit rejoindre St Theresa Point pour livrer sa cargaison de matériaux de construction. Lisa est chanceuse car elle rentre à Winnipeg avec un chargement mais elle rencontre aussi quelques difficultés.

programme.title: Dashcam en action !
programme.desc: Conducteurs distraits, animaux à l'attaque et sauvetage héroïque à ne pas manquer, le tout filmé en caméra embarquée !

programme.title: Dashcam en action !
programme.desc: Des catastrophes hilarantes au lavage auto et la réponse à une question brûlante : peut-on vraiment faire rouler une voiture au soda ? Le tout filmé en caméra embarquée !

programme.title: Thorn Bikes, l'atelier Moto
programme.desc: Les experts sont formels : les machines surpuissantes pensées pour l'asphalte ne parcourront pas un mètre dans le sable si on ne modifie pas radicalement les partie-cycles.

programme.title: Thorn Bikes, l'atelier Moto
programme.desc: Rien ne vaut un essai en conditions réelles pour se familiariser avec cet environnement hostile. Direction le Bud Racing Training Camp, un terrain spécialement conçu pour l'entrainement des pilotes dans le sable.

programme.title: High Side : Le Meilleur
programme.desc: Les essais des nouveautés, des invités, des défis et une bonne dose d'aventure : voilà pour la formule de High Side, le magazine qui s'adresse à tous les fans de moto.

programme.title: High Side : Le Meilleur
programme.desc: Les essais des nouveautés, des invités, des défis et une bonne dose d'aventure : voilà pour la formule de High Side, le magazine qui s'adresse à tous les fans de moto.

programme.title: Le convoi de l'extrême : le grand frisson
programme.desc: Steph fait son premier voyage en solitaire pour acheminer les 28 tonnes de matériel de construction jusqu'à Pikangikum. Darrell a prévu 3 livraisons en une seule journée. Todd se rend à Big Trout Lake avec 20 tonnes de matériel de construction mais le chemin qu'il doit emprunter vient de fermer. Lisa transporte des provisions à livrer et l'état des routes est déplorable avec l'arrivée du redoux. Malheureusement pour elle, le coup de chaud n'est pas que sur les routes.

programme.title: Le convoi de l'extrême : le grand frisson
programme.desc: Après avoir réussi à reprendre la route, Todd est maintenant victime d'une panne mécanique. Lisa effectue une livraison de dernière minute risquée.

programme.title: Dashcam en action !
programme.desc: Des tornades terrifiantes et une course-poursuite haletante avec la police, le tout filmé en caméra embarquée !

programme.title: Dashcam en action !
programme.desc: Des conditions météo extrêmes et des disputes de parking qui s'enflamment, le tout filmé en caméra embarquée !

programme.title: Vintage Mecanic
programme.desc: La Citroën 2CV UMAP est un véhicule extrêmement rare, produit à seulement 50 exemplaires. François, en parfait protecteur du patrimoine automobile, a décidé d'en sauver un exemplaire. Si elle repose sur une base de 2CV classique, la version UMAP se distingue par de nombreuses pièces spécifiques aujourd'hui presque introuvables. Mais il lui faut trouver des pièces quasiment disparues du marché.

programme.title: Vintage Mecanic
programme.desc: François s'est vu confier un exemplaire unique d'une Formule 3 nommée "Pygmée". Son propriétaire désire la restaurer à neuf et la remettre en configuration pour en profiter sur circuit. Au programme : restauration complète de la carrosserie, reconstruction des pièces inexistantes, remise en place des trains roulants et ajustements et réinstallations des circuits d'huile, d'essence et de refroidissement.

programme.title: Tennis : WTA Finals
programme.desc: Retransmission de matchs du célèbre tournoi de tennis des WTA Finals. C'est le dernier tournoi de la saison WTA, celui où seul les huit meilleures joueuses en simple et en double peuvent participer. Les joueuses sont divisées en deux groupes. Les deux premières de chaque groupe se retrouvent en demi-finales, et les vainqueurs rejoignent la finale qui rapporte 1500 points au classement WTA.

programme.title: Brighton & Hove Albion / Brentford
programme.desc: Brighton accueille Brentford pour la 10e journée de Premier League. Les Seagulls veulent s'imposer à domicile pour valider leurs ambitions européennes. Face à eux, des Bees rigoureux comptent sur leur force collective pour ramener des points. Un duel tactique indécis entre deux équipes ambitieuses.

programme.title: Football : Arkema Première Ligue
programme.desc: Retransmission d'un match d'Arkema Première Ligue, la première division féminine de football. Tout d'abord créée en 1919, elle réapparait en 1974 avant de devenir la 1ère division composée d'un seul groupe national que l'on connait aujourd'hui. L'Olympique Lyonnais domine largement ce championnat depuis des années. En 2024, la compétition se renomme Arkema Première Ligue.

programme.title: Fin des programmes
programme.desc: Fermeture de l'antenne à la fin des diffusions de la journée.

programme.title: Arsenal / Hull City
programme.desc: Les Gunners d'Arsenal, champions d'Angleterre en titre, reçoivent le promu Hull City qui réalise un début de saison encourageant. Bukayo Saka et les siens doivent l'emporter sur leur pelouse, afin de ne pas se faire distancer par le leader Manchester City.

programme.title: 05/06/2027 En route pour Madrid
programme.desc: Focus sur la rencontre qui oppose les surprenants et imprévisibles Norvégiens de Bodo/Glimt aux Dogues lillois.

programme.title: Paris-SG / Le Havre
programme.desc: Le Paris-SG reçoit une formation normande du Havre qui lutte pour s'installer confortablement dans la première partie du championnat et qui aborde ce déplacement en tant qu'outsider. L'objectif principal des Parisiennes sera de dicter leur rythme à domicile, au Campus PSG, et de remporter les trois points de la victoire pour ne pas se faire distancer par leurs concurrents directs que sont l'Olympique Lyonnais et le Paris FC, dans la course aux play-offs de la Première Ligue.

programme.title: Saint-Malo / Marseille
programme.desc: L'affiche entre l'US Saint-Malo et l'Olympique de Marseille constitue le match de clôture de la 8e journée de l'Arkema Première Ligue. Promu dans l'élite du football féminin cette saison, le club malouin est le seul représentant breton en Première Ligue. L'enjeu principal pour les "Diablesses" est le maintien au plus haut niveau. Du côté des Marseillaises, l'objectif sera évidemment de prendre les trois points de la victoire, pour confirmer leur excellent début de saison.

programme.title: Champions League Weekly
programme.desc: Les dernières actualités, résultats et critiques des matchs de Ligue des Champions, avec des interviews d'experts et de stars du football, condensées en images.

programme.title: Late Football Club
programme.desc: Suivez toute l'actualité foot du jour, avec le prisme des infos de la rédaction de Canal+, des infos transferts, des reportages, des interviews. Autour de la table, les journalistes et consultants de Canal+ livrent leur regard sans concession.

programme.title: Violences dans le football : Et si on se calmait ?
programme.desc: L'ancienne joueuse du PSG Laure Boulleau a consacré l'essentiel de sa vie au football. Il lui a offert ses plus belles satisfactions mais, aujourd'hui, elle fait le constat qu'il est gangrené de toute part par la violence. Elle a donc décidé d'en faire son combat. Dans ce documentaire, elle rencontre les auteurs de violences, comme les acteurs tentant d'apporter des remèdes.

programme.title: UEFA : Ce que vous n'avez pas vu
programme.desc: L'émission décortique à la loupe les matches d'UEFA Champions League à travers surtout les échanges qui ont lieu entre les joueurs sur le terrain.

programme.title: Bodø/Glimt / Lille
programme.desc: Avec deux défaites en deux matchs, Lille était déjà dos au mur en ce début de phase préliminaire de la Ligue des champions.

programme.title: Villarreal / Paris-SG
programme.desc: Forts de leur succès retentissant à Manchester City lors de la 2e journée, Désiré Doué et ses coéquipiers se déplacent en Espagne avec le costume de favoris.

programme.title: Late Football Club
programme.desc: Suivez toute l'actualité foot du jour, avec le prisme des infos de la rédaction de Canal+, des infos transferts, des reportages, des interviews. Autour de la table, les journalistes et consultants de Canal+ livrent leur regard sans concession.

programme.title: Jour de foot
programme.desc: Analyse des rencontres. Tour des stades avec les envoyés spéciaux de CANAL+ pour découvrir ce qui s'est passé et recueillir les toutes premières réactions des acteurs.

programme.title: Histoire de Champions
programme.desc: L'international français Robert Pirès a disputé 82 matchs et inscrit 14 buts en Ligue des champions, au cours de sa carrière, marquant les esprits notamment avec l'OM et Arsenal. C'est avec les Gunners d'Arsène Wenger que Pirès vit l'essentiel de son parcours européen, devenant un maestro du milieu de terrain et cumulant 63 matchs pour 11 buts dans la compétition sous e maillot londonien.

programme.title: Les acrobates du football
programme.desc: "Bicyclette\.

programme.title: Late Football Club
programme.desc: Suivez toute l'actualité foot du jour, avec le prisme des infos de la rédaction de Canal+, des infos transferts, des reportages, des interviews. Autour de la table, les journalistes et consultants de Canal+ livrent leur regard sans concession.

programme.title: Golf+, le mag
programme.desc: Toute l'actualité golfique des tours mondiaux : les plus beaux coups des circuits américain et européen, portraits de joueurs, analyses et résultats avec les journalistes et consultants de la rédaction. Toutes les informations du PGA Tour, du PGA Tour Champions et des tournois féminins sont également abordées dans le magazine, qui revient aussi sur les derniers résultats et les classements.

programme.title: Mister George : l'extraordinaire vie de George Eddy
programme.desc: Ce documentaire retrace la carrière et la vie de George Eddy. Celui-ci n'a pas seulement révolutionné le commentaire sportif et inspiré des millions de téléspectateurs, célèbres comme anonymes : il a pénétré la culture pop. France Inter, L'Equipe ou encore le New York Times consacrent des portraits à ce personnage haut en couleurs, qui a traversé les époques en laissant son empreinte inimitable sur la télévision et le basket. Alors que l'heure de la retraite approche, cette icône de Canal+ mérite que sa carrière hors du commun et sa vie romanesque soient retracées dans un documentaire où culture et sport s'entremêlent.

programme.title: Fin des programmes
programme.desc: Fermeture de l'antenne à la fin des diffusions de la journée.

programme.title: Toulouse / ASM Clermont
programme.desc: Sèchement battu à Pau (34-14) lors de la huitième journée, le Stade Toulousain se doit de réagir à l'occasion de la réception de Clermont. Suite à ce revers, Antoine Dupont et ses équipiers avaient vu Bègles-Bordeaux ne revenir qu'à un point en tête du championnat, et il ne faudra pas laisser de points en route ce soir, d'autant que les Bordelais se déplacent dans le même temps sur le terrain du promu Vannes, lanterne rouge du classement.

programme.title: Pau / Perpignan
programme.desc: Après avoir fait chuter le leader Toulouse (34-14) lors de la huitième journée, Pau entend bien poursuivre sur la même dynamique en recevant Perpignan. A l'inverse, les Catalans sortent d'une défaite douloureuse à domicile face à Toulon (24-25) qui les a mis dans une mauvaise posture au championnat. Les Palois comptent bien en profiter pour enfoncer le clou, et rester à hauteur de Toulouse et Bègles-Bordeaux.

programme.title: Canal Rugby Club
programme.desc: Le magazine met à l'honneur le Top 14 dont les rencontres sont proposées en exclusivité et en intégralité sur les chaînes Canal+. L'émission propose encore plus d'immersion en direct des terrains chaque week-end et plus de reportages inside et d'interviews de personnalités du rugby afin de décrypter les enjeux et résultats de chaque journée.

programme.title: La Rochelle / Bayonne
programme.desc: La rencontre entre le Stade Rochelais et l'Aviron Bayonnais est l'affiche de clôture de la 9e journée du Top 14, au Stade Marcel-Deflandre.

programme.title: Canal Rugby Club le débrief
programme.desc: Le Canal Rugby Club, l'émission référence du rugby encadre le grand match en prime avec un avant match complet et un debrief. L'ensemble des statistiques ainsi que tous les résultats et toutes les réactions à chaud des joueurs et des coachs sont passés en revue dans le magazine consacré au ballon ovale et au championnat de France Top 14.

programme.title: 4e tour
programme.desc: C'est la dernière journée de compétition sur le parcours d'El Cardonal, à l'issue de laquelle on connaîtra le nom du successeur de Ben Griffin au palmarès de l'épreuve. L'an passé, ce dernier s'était en effet imposé avec un score exceptionnel de -29 sous le par. Le joueur américain sera présent pour remettre son titre en jeu, tout comme d'autres anciens vainqueurs : Austin Eckroat (vainqueur en 2024) et Erik van Rooyen (vainqueur en 2023).

programme.title: Narbonne / Nice
programme.desc: Retransmission d'un match du championnat de France de deuxième division de rugby appelé Pro D2, une compétition de rugby à XV. Organisé depuis 1924, le championnat de deuxième division a longtemps été amateur avant d'obtenir le statut professionnel en 2000 et comporte maintenant seize clubs qui se battent pour l'accession dans l'élite du rugby français.

programme.title: Valence-Romans / Nevers
programme.desc: Retransmission d'un match du championnat de France de deuxième division de rugby appelé Pro D2, une compétition de rugby à XV. programme.title: La course
programme.desc: Le Grand Prix de Sao Paulo se déroule sur le mythique Autodromo José Carlos Pace d'Interlagos. Cette épreuve s'annonce cruciale pour le jeune prodige italien Kimi Antonelli, qui domine largement le championnat du monde, au volant de sa Mercedes.

programme.title: Fractionné Rugby
programme.desc: Sport noble par excellence, le rugby figure parmi les disciplines les plus populaires. Garants du fairplay, les joueurs cachent de véritables émotions sous leurs impressionnantes carapaces. Découvres des belles histoires liées au monde de l'ovalie dans ce magazine consacré à ce sport.

programme.title: Nouvelle-Zélande / Australie
programme.desc: Pour ce premier match de la Bledisloe Cup 2026, la Nouvelle-Zélande accueille l'Australie à l'Eden Park d'Auckland. La Bledisloe Cup se dispute cette année sur deux confrontations sèches. Après cette manche à Auckland, le match retour et décisif se tiendra le 17 octobre à l'Accor Stadium de Sydney.

programme.title: Australie / Nouvelle-Zélande
programme.desc: Le deuxième match de la Bledisloe Cup oppose l'Australie à la Nouvelle-Zélande, à l'Accor Stadium de Sydney. Le match aller s'est déroulé le 10 octobre, à l'Eden Park d'Auckland.

programme.title: Snooker : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Après Luca Brecel en 2023, Kyren Wilson en 2024 et Zhao Xintong en 2025, qui va être sacré champion du monde de snooker, cette année, au Crucible Theatre de Sheffield ? L'an dernier, Zhao Xintong avait battu en finale le Gallois Mark Williams (18-12). Il devenait également le premier joueur chinois à obtenir le titre mondial.

programme.title: Endurance : 6 Heures d'Imola

L'an dernier, la Ferrari de James Calado, Antonio Giovinazzi et Alessandro Pier Guidi s'était imposée devant une BMW et une Alpine, pilotée par Jules Gounon, Frédéric Makowiecki et Mick Schumacher.

programme.desc: Le magazine devrait revenir sur l'Open de Los Cabos, au Mexique, disputé du 5 au 8 novembre. Le tournoi fera l'objet d'un résumé des trois premiers tours, un large résumé du dernier tour, accompagnés d'interviews et d'images pour ce tournoi comptant pour le PGA Tour, avec 500 points FedExCup attribué au vainqueur. L'an passé, c'est l'Américain Ben Griffin qui s'était imposé.

programme.title: Intérieur sport
programme.desc: Cette saison, Oihan Guillamoundeguy découvre la première division européenne. Plus jeune Français à ce niveau, il détonne par son jeu flamboyant, sa fougue et une ascension fulgurante malgré son aversion pour le golf pendant sa jeunesse. Accompagné par son mentor et par une famille soutenante, le Landais de 21 ans veut continuer sa progression vers le sommet. A sa manière : " pleine balle ".

programme.title: Décrypté
programme.desc: Dans ce tout premier épisode de Décrypté consacré au golf, Matthieu Pavon revient sur un moment historique du sport tricolore : la première victoire française sur le PGA Tour, le circuit professionnel de golf masculin le plus prestigieux au monde. Le Bordelais décrypte les moments clés de cette victoire historique au Farmers Insurance Open 2024.

programme.desc: "L'Equipe de choc" revient pour une nouvelle saison toujours animée par France Pierron. Accompagnée notamment de Pierre Bouby, Camille Macali et Julien Aliane, la journaliste et sa bande analysent l'actualité et les tendances du sport dans un esprit vivant et décalé. Débats, informations et prises de position rythment une émission ouverte aux passerelles avec les médias, la culture et la société.

programme.title: L'Equipe de Greg
programme.desc: Grégory Ascher reprend les commandes de "L'Equipe de Greg" pour une nouvelle saison. Entouré de chroniqueurs et consultants, l'animateur passe en revue l'actualité du football, ses images fortes et ses principaux débats. Analyses, informations, séquences d'humeur, échanges avec les téléspectateurs et interactivité rythment ce rendez-vous.

programme.title: Summit Fever
programme.desc: Michael et son ami JP vont enfin réaliser leur rêve de gravir les trois grands sommets des Alpes : la Dent de Géant, le Cervin et l'Eiger. Ils se joignent à un groupe de têtes brûlées qui prend des risques inconsidérés. Lors de la dernière sortie, le petit groupe se retrouve pris au piège dans une tempête...

programme.title: L'Equipe du soir
programme.desc: Lancée en 2008, "L'Équipe du soir" fait peau neuve. Toujours présenté par Olivier Ménard, l'emblématique talk-show de la chaîne revient à la rentrée avec une équipe de chroniqueurs renouvelée et resserrée. Les intervenants conservés seront davantage présents autour de la table afin d'apporter un nouvel élan aux débats et aux analyses. L'émission change également de rythme, quittant la grille du week-end pour une diffusion du mardi au vendredi.

programme.title: Super Car
programme.desc: Una lettera anonima informa Michael (David Hasselhoff) che Danny, corridore di motocross, morto in un incidente durante una corsa, e' stato ucciso. Il detective scopre che l'autrice della missiva e' Sabrina (Lydia Cornell), fidanzata della vittima, che teme per la vita di Kelly (John Macchia), il migliore amico di Danny. Michael, scoperto il colpevole, con l'aiuto dell'inseparabile auto K.I.T.T., riesce durante una gara a salvare Kelly facendogli persino vincere la corsa.

programme.title: Super Car
programme.desc: Michael (David Hasselhoff) ha il compito di proteggere il dottor Klaus Bergstrom (Peter Mark Richman), famoso ricercatore scientifico, e sua nipote Cristina (Suzanne Barnes) da eventuali attentati. L'esperto, conosciuto in tutto il mondo, si trova, infatti, in citta', per partecipare ad un simposio internazionale. Michael e' molto preoccupato sapendo che il malvagio Garthe, suo sosia, con l'aiuto del suo indistruttibile autotreno, GOLIATH, a' evaso di prigione.

programme.title: La Signora Del West
programme.desc: Michaela giunge da Sully con Nube che Corre, pronta a curargli le ferite. Il sergente O' Connor li trova e cattura Nube che Corre.

programme.title: La Signora Del West
programme.desc: Il Dr. Mike riprende a lavorare dopo la nascita della figlia Katie. Durante la sua "maternita'", il Dr. Andrew Cook l'ha sostituita alla clinica e ora si offre di assisterla.

programme.title: La Signora Del West
programme.desc: Il Dr. Mike sembra non riuscire a conciliare l'esercizio della professione di medico con le cure per la figlia Katie.

programme.title: Super Car
programme.desc: Granthe, il malvagio sosia di Michael (David Hasselhoff), riesce coi suoi soliti mezzi a sostituire con una perfetta copia il dottor Bergstrom (Peter Mark Richman), famoso ricercatore scientifico. Michael, dopo aver scoperto l'inganno, fa in modo di ritrovare il vero studioso. Ancora una volta si vede costretto a combattere con K.I.T.T., la sua fedele auto, contro Garthe e il suo fortissimo autotreno, GOLIATH.

programme.title: Super Car
programme.desc: Michael (David Hasselhoff) accetta di indagare circa la sparizione del progetto di un nuovo sofisticato giocattolo, Matteo, creato da Gina Adams (Alexa Hamilton), brillante designer. In realta' il caso e' solo un pretesto per tenerlo occupato. Gina, infatti, a sua insaputa, lavora per Cameron Zachary (John Vernon), criminale internazionale che usa la societa' di giocattoli come copertura per lavorare ad un piano per la realizzazione di una pistola laser.

programme.title: Super Car
programme.desc: Arthur Abrahms (Tom illeran), brillante avvocato e investigatore federale, e' stato ucciso. Michael (David Hasselhoff), in collaborazione con K.I.T.T., la sua inseparabile auto, geniale computer, e' ingaggiato per risolvere il caso. In realta' Michael non e' l'unico ad indagare sull'omicidio; anche David Dalton (Charles Taylor), che lavora per Archibald Hendley, vecchio capo del Dipartimento di Giustizia, e'' stato chiamato per lo stesso problema. I due finiranno per collaborare, inserendo nel gruppo di indagini anche Joanna St. John (Jo Anna Pettet), giovane vedova della vittima.

programme.title: La Casa Nella Prateria
programme.desc: Laura cerca di far colpo su Jimmy Hill, di cui e' follemente innamorata, ma riceve una grande delusione quando scopre che il giovane e' interessato a Samantha Higgings.

programme.title: La Casa Nella Prateria
programme.desc: Mary Ingalls, chiamata ad insegnare nella scuola di un piccolo villaggio, si scontra con la tirannica Miss Peel.

programme.title: La Casa Nella Prateria

programme.title: La Casa Nella Prateria

programme.title: Colombo
programme.desc: Abigail Mitchell (Ruth Gordon) e' una famosa scrittrice di libri gialli ossessionata dalla morte di una sua giovane nipote. Abigail ritiene che suo nipote Edmund Galvin (Charles Frank) abbia assassinato la ragazza e quindi prepara un piano per ucciderlo. La tecnica utilizzata per l'omicidio e' quella adottata dal protagonista di uno dei romanzi di Abigail. Il tenente Colombo (Peter Falk) viene incaricato di indagare sull'assassinio del giovane Edmund...

programme.title: Colombo
programme.desc: Il dottor Bart Keppel (Robert Culp), noto ricercatore, usa il ricatto per favorire la sua carriera. Quando realizza che una delle sue vittime, Victor Norris (Robert Middleton), e' deciso a denunciarlo al procuratore distrettuale, non esita ad ucciderlo cercando di incolpare la moglie di Norris (Louise Latham). Come sempre il tenente Colombo (Peter Falk) riuscira' a smascherare il colpevole.

programme.title: Il Principe Delle Donne

Quando conosce quella che sarà il suo nuovo capo, l'affascinante Jacqueline, se ne innamora ma scopre che la donna è in realtà una mangia uomini. Riuscirà a conquistarla.

programme.title: Inga Lindstrēma. Saldā dzīve
programme.desc: Konditore Juna dzīvo Stokholmā kopā ar savu mazo meitiņu Idu. Kad priekšnieks uz viņu kārtējo reizi sakliedz, Juna bez liekām runām pamet darbu. Īstajā brīdī viņa saņem saucienu pēc palīdzības no dzimtās puses. Tēvocis Nils ir salauzis roku, un viņam steidzami nepieciešama palīdzība maiznīcā. Nilam ir arī problēmas ar kaimiņieni Annu, kura nesen pārcēlusies atpakaļ uz pilsētu. Tā Juna iepazīstas ar Annas dēlu Emīlu. Negaidīti atgriežas arī Idas tēvs un Junas kādreizējā mīlestība Vigo un līdz ar viņu – atkal jauni solījumi..

programme.title: Viņas melo labāk 2
programme.desc: Jolanta paziņo Konrādam, ka precas ar Māri. Kārlis pārmet Margo Roberta dēļ. Konrāds izseko Jolantu, vēlas ar viņu parunāt. Kārlis dod Arvim padomu uzvilkt ložu necauršaujamo vesti. Marta ar Jāni apciemo Kristīni. Konrāds ir gatavs piekaut Māri, bet viņš aizbēg. Arvi atkal gaida nepatīkama tikšanās ar slepkavu.

programme.title: Viņas melo labāk 2
programme.desc: Arvis vēlreiz pārliecinās, ka Māris par visām varītēm centīsies viņu nogalināt. Martai par lielu brīnumu, Jānis ar Arvi pa nakti kļūst par labiem draugiem. Margarita satiek Jolantu. Viņa paziņo, ka nevēlas vairs kontaktēties ar Kristīni. Kristīne meklē Jolantu un izseko viņu līdz vietai, kur negaidīti kļūst par nežēlīga nozieguma aculiecinieci.

programme.title: Kristīgā programma "Ticīgo uzvaras balss"
programme.desc: Reliģisks šovs, ko vada Kenets un Glorija Koplendi, vieni no vispazīstamākajiem TV evaņģēlistiem pasaulē.

programme.title: Izgaršo Latviju 5
programme.desc: Ir laiks uzzināt, kuri ir paši iemīļotākie mūsu zemes produkti! Rimi gardēži - Latvijas garšas pazinēji un pētnieki, kā arī jaunu garšu eksperimentētāji - apceļos visu Latviju, lai kopīgi radītu mūsdienu Latvijas garšu.

programme.title: Šefu gaidījāt? 6
programme.desc: Grupas "Borowa MC" līdera Aigara Runča laiku piepilda četras nodarbes - nopietns biroja darbs, sports, ģimene un mūzika. Virtuvē viņš nav viesis, bet lielākoties asistents savai sievai. Šodien viņš kļūs par šefpavāres Inas Poliščenko asistentu, lai pie viena galda sēdinātu divas pasaules - kolēģi no biznesa vides un savu treneri.

programme.title: Safīrs
programme.desc: Džemile pārmet Aleinai, ka viņa pavadījusi nakti ar Sarpu, taču Aleinai ir plāns, kā nodrošināt sev vietu Gulsoju ģimenē. Jamans un Okans iekuļas pamatīgās problēmās ar kontrabandas pārvadātāju, taču Bekirs viņus izglābj. Gulfema piedraud Vuralam pastāstīt to, ka Bāde nav viņa meita.

programme.title: Mani remonta noteikumi 7
